name: Taradino
description:
Taradino is an open-source modern source port of Rise of the Triad: Dark War (1994), Apogee Software's classic over-the-top first-person shooter. Built with SDL2, it brings high-flying missile combat natively to Linux.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit systems with high-resolution display rendering
- Smooth mouselook controls, customizable key bindings, and gamepad support
- All original playable characters with distinct speed and health characteristics
- Ludicrous gibs, trampolines, dog mode, god mode, and explosive rocket weaponry
- Restored digital audio and Roland Sound Canvas MIDI music playback
